intro.text: A festival in Torio City that Yumi dreams of attending in disguise, though her warden discourages it.
A yearly festival in Torio City where the nation's finest art, plays and projects are shown in honour of its queen and the spirits.

description.text: It fills the city centre, gathered around a big bannered courtyard and the grand exhibit hall.

items.text: Scholars of the Institute of Mechanical Solutions unveiled the father machine at the festival and switched it on.
